The word here rendered scales of the plurals, is the singular noun _pheles ;_ while that rendered balance, is the dual word _mazain._ The English therefore would better accord with the original, were the term in the translation reversed in order, and read thus: " who hath weighed the mountain in a balance, and the little scales".<x_0.5537><y_0.1945><class_Text>
